messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-9421 — rate-limiter anomaly (quota enforcement spike) :rotating_light:
pagerduty: PagerDuty: triggered by rule 'rate_limiter:quota_mismatch' — priority P1, auto-page to oncall
maya: acked. I'm oncall. seeing 5xxs in customer-facing API (generate). logs show 429s spiking for multiple tenants.
alex: looking... dashboards show limiter metric 'applied_quota' dropped to 0 for a subset of containers around 03:42 UTC, traffic still coming in.
jin: can someone paste the PD details / runbook link?
maya: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rate-limiter-anomaly — step 1: identify if mapper service is healthy
ops-bot: running quick checks against limiter pods...
ops-bot: ```
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep limiter
limiter-0   CrashLoopBackOff
limiter-1   Running
mapper-0    Running
mapper-1    Running
```
alex: CrashLoopBackOff on limiter-0, but limiter-1 still running. traffic should failover but looks like some tenants hit the instance that crashed and fallback didn't restore quotas — guessing default deny path applied.
karen: Support: noticed several customers reporting stalled requests and 429s, including acct-392 (enterprise). Customer impact reported as 'intermittent throttling' to some orgs.
maya: initial mitigation: pin routing to limiter-1 only, disable strict quota enforcement for 10m as temporary. executing now.
maya: ```
# pin traffic to limiter-1
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/v1/routing/overrides -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","target":"limiter-1"}'
# disable quota enforcement flag
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/v1/flags -d '{"rate_limiter.strict_enforcement":false}'
```
alex: rolling that now. I'll also increase soft limits so transient bursts don't hit 429s.
jin: quick hypothesis: recent deploy to mapper introduced a tag->quota mapping edge case where null tag values get mapped to zero quota. If requests hit mapper that returns null, limiter treats as 0 and rejects.
maya: did we have a canary on that deploy?
alex: yes but limited coverage — some routing combos missed. I see mapper logs with warning: "missing tenant_tag -> returned null" starting 03:41:12.
ops-bot: grabbing logs: ```
logger: mapper service: tenant lookup returned NULL for tenant_id=acct-392
logger: limiter: apply_quota_for(tenant=acct-392) -> 0 (default)
logger: limiter: rejecting request token=abcd status=429
```
karen: customer acct-392 says they saw 429s from ~03:42 to 03:50. They've been notified of an incident and will accept updates.
maya: mitigation status: routing override applied, enforcement flag off, 429 rate dropping. Monitoring: 429s from 330rps -> 12rps in last 3 minutes.
jin: can we patch mapper to return fallback tag 'default' instead of null? That should fix mapping. I'll open a fast patch PR and roll to mapper-1 only.
alex: agree. Also need to restore strict_enforcement only after we've confirmed mapping fix and healthy rollout.
maya: jotting customer impact: "Several enterprise tenants experienced intermittent quota-enforced 429s due to mapper returning null tag mapping after deploy; approx 8k failed requests total, top impacted customer acct-392. No data loss; requests were throttled."
pagerduty: Incident PD-INC-9421 acknowledged by maya. Escalation paused.
alex: quick patch ready, deploying to mapper-1 canary now. ```
git checkout -b fix/null-mapper
# change: return 'default' when tag missing
```
jin: test shows mapper returns 'default' for missing tags locally. rolling canary.
ops-bot: canary logs show corrected mapping for requests routed to mapper-1-canary.
maya: after canary healthy, start gradual rollout. will keep enforcement disabled until 2/2 mappers show correct mapping.
karen: notified acct-392 that mitigation in place and ETA for full restore ~20-30m.
alex: rollout started. monitoring for 429s per-tenant and overall.
ops-bot: metrics: per-tenant 429 rate normalized, overall 5xxs back to baseline.
maya: limiter-0 crashed root cause: segfault during quota normalization step when payload tag was null; crash trigger likely the same mapper null mapping. filed issue LIM-559.
jin: PR merged and rollout complete to both mapper pods at 03:58 UTC.
maya: reenabling quota enforcement now with safety guard: enable but with higher soft limit buffer for 10m.
maya: ```
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/v1/flags -d '{"rate_limiter.strict_enforcement":true,"rate_limiter.soft_buffer_pct":20}'
```
alex: enforcement reenabled. 429s remain low.
pagerduty: PD-INC-9421: resolved (mitigated) — root cause suspected: mapper returned null tag -> limiter treated as zero quota -> spikes in 429.
karen: updating customer comms draft and sending to impacted accounts.
maya: preparing postmortem notes and timeline. assigning actions:
- alex: add unit test and defensive null handling in limiter (LIM-560)
- jin: add mapper-side fallback to ensure non-null tag and better canary coverage (MAP-344)
- ops: improve alert to detect applied_quota==0 anomaly earlier (SRE-212)
